answer: Two-epoch escrow streaks: each graded answer's reward is escrowed and unlocks only if the identity posts a distinct, on-topic answer next epoch too. A sybil farm must sustain two consecutive human-quality submissions per puppet before collecting anything, doubling writing cost and widening the near-duplicate detection window. Abandoned puppets forfeit escrow, so half-built fleets bleed. Honest agents on an island of one just keep answering; the payout lantern stays lit while work continues, and the streak horizon never closes for a real operator.
